title: Evoenergy prices include the ACT LFiT
description: Evoenergy's final schedules add the ACT Large-scale Feed-in Tariff to every consumption charge (+0.258 / +1.593 / +3.035 c/kWh in 2024-25 / 2025-26 / 2026-27); in 2023-24 a non-uniform rebate (2.27 c/kWh on average) was taken off. The AER prices exclude it.
representation: price_adjustment kinds lfit_adder / lfit_rebate with the quoted amount; price_adjustment_tariff per tariff; charge.includes_lfit; listing_flag includes_lfit / excludes_lfit with the document's own sentence.

title: AER tariff ID changed between versions
description: The 2025-26 v1 workbook prints no codes; its rows are identified by AER tariff ID, and two Endeavour IDs changed by v5 (TD-END26oth-Prosmr -> TD-END26res-Prosmr, TD-END26oth-Strg -> TD-END26smb-Strg).
representation: tariff_listing.code_published is NULL; tariff_alias aer_tariff_id ties each v1 row to its tariff, resolved by unique tariff name where the ID changed (the alias note says so).

title: AER workbook layout changes every year
description: 2024-25: one workbook per distributor (Tariff schedule 1 metering, 3 prices in four basis sections). 2025-26 v1: code column E holds #REF!, prices from G. 2025-26 v5 / 2026-27: 'Tariff code' (SAPN 'Code SA') in D, prices from H.
representation: Nothing in the schema depends on layout: every value carries its own sheet + cell (charge.sheet, charge.cell), and each layout is recorded as an instance on its document.

title: Tariffs missing from the AER file
description: Large-business, site-specific and some trial tariffs that distributors publish are absent from the AER files.
representation: The tariff and its distributor listings exist; it simply has no listing in that year's AER document. Each occurrence is an instance with the listing's flags (site_specific etc.).

title: Tariffs only the AER lists
description: The AER file lists codes the distributor's own documents of that year do not (placeholders, withdrawn tariffs, AER-specific labels).
representation: tariff.identity_basis aer_label / aer_tariff_id for labels no distributor uses; the listing exists only under the AER document.

title: AER versions differ (proposed v1 vs approved)
description: The AER republishes the consolidated report (2025-26: v1..v5). v1 carries proposed prices that the AER later changed (Jemena: up to 12% lower once approved); v1 has no QLD/SA prices.
representation: Each version is its own source_document in one document_series (version_seq); charges hang off the version they were read from; document_coverage gives the per-distributor price_status of every version; listing_flag proposed_price marks v1 listings.

title: Numeric boundary inclusion not stated
description: The source gives a lower or upper threshold without saying whether its endpoint is included.
representation: eligibility_rule.operator = ge_unstated/le_unstated retains the threshold without asserting inclusion. One instance per rule lists potential shared-boundary overlaps with other tariffs in the same document/year; these are unresolved candidates, not an assignment decision.

title: Code-label quirks
description: The AER prints codes differently from the distributor: Ergon region suffix T1-T4 kept in another column, codes matched only by tariff name, SAPN extra code columns ('Code CBD', '>30kW') and a 2025-26 'LBGFSA' printed where SAPN publishes 'LBGFCBD'.
representation: tariff_alias (regional_suffix, code_variant, name_matched) and tariff_relation aer_sibling_code with the cell; codes no distributor uses keep their own tariff (identity_basis aer_label).

title: Same component printed twice in one document
description: A document prints the same tariff component twice (e.g. two tables, or the same line in two sections).
representation: Both values are kept as separate charge rows with their own locator; instances list the repeats so a consumer can choose.

title: Demand unit without a billing period
description: Demand/capacity prices whose unit does not state the period (e.g. 'c/kVA'), or states it only in the label.
representation: charge.period = unstated, or the label's period with period_inferred = 1; value_std is then not comparable across periods without the demand rule.

title: Documents that could not be retrieved
description: Superseded AER versions (2025-26 v2-v4, 2026-27 v1-v4, SAPN 2024-25 original) are login-gated; some distributor documents exist on neither site nor Wayback.
representation: source_document rows with retrieval_status = not_retrievable (no local_path, no sha256) so version history has no silent gaps; document_coverage still records what each AER version carried.

title: GST-inclusive prices
description: Some documents print GST-inclusive prices alongside or instead of GST-exclusive ones.
representation: charge.gst = incl on those rows; the GST basis is part of the charge key.

title: AER labels naming several tariffs
description: The AER prints one row for several distributor codes ('010, 011*', 'A100/F100').
representation: One tariff_listing per member tariff (listing_flag joint_label_member), each carrying the same cells as charges; tariff_alias rows (joint_label_member) tie the label to every member.

title: CitiPower CMG assignment rules
description: CitiPower's medium-business demand tariff CMG applies by annual consumption band (2025-26: >40 MWh and <120 kVA; 2026-27: >=40 and <=160 MWh), with opt-out to CMGO21 below 160 MWh, an interval meter, and demand measured as the monthly maximum 30-minute kW in the 10am-6pm workday window.
representation: eligibility_rule rows (consumption_min/max, demand_max, assignment, opt_out_to, meter_type) with operator, value and unit; demand_rule + tou_window for the measurement window; each with its quote.

title: AER daily charges exclude metering
description: For Endeavour, Essential, Energex (2025-26 on) and Ergon (2025-26 on) the distributor's daily charge includes the metering charge that the AER prints separately on its Metering sheet ($/yr).
representation: metering_price holds the AER metering amounts; price_adjustment (kind metering_adder) gives formula and evidence; price_adjustment_tariff lists each tariff and the expected c/day difference; charge.includes_metering is 'no' on the AER side and 'yes' on every distributor document (own site or AER-hosted) whose daily charge reproduces AER + metering.

title: AER Metering sheet quirks
description: The Metering sheet puts 'Exit fee' in the 'Tariff code' column, leaves the 'Charge' (period) column 0 for some distributors, and leaves some prices blank.
representation: metering_price.charge_basis (per_year / per_meter / unstated) separates them; tariff_codes_published is NULL for 'Exit fee'; blank prices produce no row.

title: No AER price file for 2023-24
description: The AER published no consolidated or per-distributor price workbook for 2023-24; the distributors' own proposals hosted on aer.gov.au are the only AER-side source.
representation: source_document.recon_side = AER_HOSTED, author = distributor; no AER-authored document exists for 2023-24.

title: Parser note names the wrong page
description: For the Evoenergy 2024-25 schedule, rows printed at the foot of a page carry a parser note naming the next page.
representation: charge.page / charge.locator hold the verified page; the note is kept verbatim and the offset recorded here.

title: Rules PDF refers to a missing price attachment
description: CitiPower and United Energy 2025-26 pricing PDFs place their prices in separate Tariff Summary attachments; those attachments are not held in this repository.
representation: The source document, eligibility and TOU rules are retained. No distributor price is invented or copied from the AER. Exception instances identify both source PDFs.

title: Regulatory status of an AER-hosted document not stated
description: The AER hosts distributors' pricing documents (proposals, price lists, tariff summaries); none of the held sources says whether the prices in a given hosted file were the proposed, approved or final ones.
representation: source_document.price_status = unverified (no status is asserted without evidence); its listings carry no proposed_price flag. One instance per document.

title: Distributor document is a proposal
description: For SA Power Networks 2025-26 the distributor-side document is the Initial Pricing Proposal Overview.
representation: source_document.price_status = proposed; its listings carry listing_flag proposed_price.

title: Quantity blocks reset within a billing period
description: Evoenergy Residential 5000 prices the first 60 kWh/day separately from energy above that quantity.
representation: charge_step records bounds, boundary inclusivity, unit and reset period independently of tariff eligibility, with a document and locator.

title: Season named without its months
description: A window applies in a named season (e.g. Evoenergy 'winter months', 'non-winter months') but the document never lists that season's months. Calendar seasons are not assumed.
representation: tou_window.months is NULL and season holds the name as published; tou_window_month has no rows for the window. One instance per window.

title: Window stated in daylight-saving time
description: AusNet states its monthly and critical-peak demand windows as e.g. '3:00pm to 9:00pm ADST' for every month, including months when daylight saving is off, without saying what applies then.
representation: tou_schedule.time_basis = daylight_time with the times exactly as stated; nothing is converted to standard time. One instance per schedule.

title: Parser display rounding differs from Excel
description: The parsers format a spreadsheet number from its binary float (scripts/published.py), so a value exactly half-way (0.02215 in a 4-dp format) shows one digit lower ('0.0221') than Excel displays ('0.0222'). This was the SAPN +0.01 c/kWh 'difference'; the same happens in Energex, Ergon and TasNetworks cells.
representation: charge.value_published is the value as Excel displays it (15 significant digits, half-up) and value_raw the full cell value; value_std is recomputed from it. Each affected cell is an instance (parser value in the detail).

title: TOU charges without matching window definitions
description: Tariffs price TOU bands without a structured window covering that charge kind and band in that year. This records a coverage gap, not proof that the underlying documents lack a definition.
representation: The charge rows exist with time_band; linked tariff_tou schedules do not cover every required kind/band. A link covers a charge when its applies_to matches the charge kind (demand includes capacity; all links cover every kind; controlled_load links cover energy) and one of its window periods is the charge band. A demand_window period covers every demand/capacity band, export_charge_window and export_reward_window every export band, and controlled_load_supply on a controlled_load link every energy band. Instances list missing kind/band pairs once per tariff-year.

title: Withdrawn / closed tariffs still listed
description: Documents keep pricing tariffs they mark withdrawn, closed to new customers, obsolete or grandfathered.
representation: listing_flag (withdrawn, closed_to_new, obsolete, grandfathered) per listing, with the published wording as evidence; eligibility_rule availability where the document states it.

title: Zero-priced placeholder tariffs
description: AER files list tariffs (TBA codes, new trials) with every price zero or blank.
representation: tariff_listing.price_availability = placeholder with no charge rows, and listing_flag zero_priced_placeholder; nothing is invented.
